data.name: Spoopcore 3D
data.detailed_description:
Reggie just wanted to live a normal life. To knit sweaters, go to the park, feed the ducks, and spend time with his boyfriend. Unfortunately for him, he is not supposed to be here. Nobody knows quite how he managed to escape from Hell, but now that his god has finally tracked him down, his world is about to be turned upside down. He is not alone, however; and what better allies to have than a group of anarchist ducks who build anti-god weapons? As Reggie, you must track down your avian comrades across dimensions, kill their oppressors, and take their weapons. And when it's all over, take the fight to god himself.

  • Go fast: using all your movement tricks, build up insane speeds and launch yourself across the map

  • Do trick shots: every weapon has a primary and secondary fire, and at least one combo you can do with another weapon.

  • Explore: every level has secrets with ducks to rescue and bring back to their home dimension.

  • Take on levels in any order: Each dimension can be accessed in whatever order you wish, and in between normal levels, you can visit the ducks you've rescued in the hub world.

  • Tell me how you really feel: If a level sucked, tell it right to its face! This doesn't do anything, but doesn't it feel nice?

  • God: a tyrant who rules over the universe with an iron fist, sending sentient beings to endure eternal torment for not finding their purpose in life. Nobody knows where he truly came from or why he has the powers he does. What we do know, though, is that he does have a weakness.

  • Duck Anarchist Militia Network: A group of ducks hell bent on creating a better world, free of domination and hierarchy. Once a powerful force, they are now a shadow of their former selves, as God has scattered their members across dimensions.

  • Reggie: A simple slime living a simple life. A life that will sadly be complicated by the machinations of powers far greater than him. Don't worry; he'll take it in stride.

  • Bunny Loaf: A type of devotee to God who has undergone extreme body modification procedures to resemble God's favored race of creatures. Through their devotion, they can unlock a fraction of the power afforded to the chosen species.

  • Punchy Loaf: A cautionary tale for all bunny loaves: this is what you will become if you waver from your mission. The regrets they have have cursed their skin to rot and their powers to disappear. All they have left is blind rage at the world that did this to them.

  • Loaf Gunner: The elite chosen species ordained by God to be his servants. They are the pattern on which all the rest of his servants are based. They are the ultimate form that the others strive to achieve but never can. Their connection to the divine affords them great power.

  • Sluggy: Some believe these creatures were once slimes before they became servants of God, and that his divine power transformed them into the form they now take. It is not known why they always hide under boxes, as they seem to have lost the capacity for language at some point in their transformation. It is speculated, however, that they simply cannot stand to look at people different from them for too long.

  • Snailey: A closely related species to Sluggy, probably engineered to be builders, considering all the hammers they have. However, they have never been observed doing anything with them besides throwing them at their enemies.

  • Carrion Carl: These heavily modified dragons have lost their ability to fly and instead slither upon the ground and eat everything in their path. It doesn't matter what it is in front of them; as long as it's meat, they will eat it, including their own kind. Some speculate they were specially bred to have a captive audience for a chain of restaurants.

All these freaks and more are waiting for you!

data.short_description: Spoopcore 3D is a low-poly 3D platformer/FPS hybrid where you play as a slime named Reggie on a mission to save ducks from across the multiverse and kill a god. Zoom through levels, find secrets, and dispatch enemies using weapon combos.
